info.title: UCP Shopping Service - WebMCP
info.description: WebMCP interface for the UCP Shopping service. Each method is a WebMCP tool that a business page registers: the method `name` is the tool name, the `params` are the properties of the tool's input schema, and the `result` is the value the tool returns. There is no endpoint: the page that registers the tools serves them, and the tools act on the session the page holds, so they take no resource `id`. Schema references are logical pointers; the actual payload shape is determined by the capabilities the page offers.

methods.name: get_checkout
methods.description: Returns the checkout the page holds.

methods.name: update_checkout
methods.description: Update Checkout is a full replacement operation. See the Checkout capability for the rules.

methods.name: complete_checkout
methods.description: Places the order. MUST be idempotent: once the order is placed, a repeated call returns the completed checkout without placing another order. See the Checkout capability for status and order semantics.

methods.name: cancel_checkout
methods.description: Cancels the checkout. Optional: a business MAY register this tool; when registered it carries consequentialHint. A repeated call on a canceled checkout returns it unchanged.
